arch.unit_pool: AttnPool over tokens at each 20 ms bin (units for spikes / spike_lfp; motor channels for LFP).
arch.temporal: After pooling, A1/Anat Transformer is causal self-attention over time (n_layers=1, nhead=4, d=64). GRU has no temporal attention weights.
arch.bands: Bands are feature dimensions inside UnitEncoder, not tokens. Band focus = first-layer |W| share + occlusion ΔR² + attended-token band lift.

feat.spikes: feat_dim=1 log1p spike count per unit
feat.lfp: feat_dim=6 log10 band power per motor channel (δ θ α β low-γ high-γ)
feat.spike_lfp: feat_dim=7 unit rate concatenated with that electrode's 6 bands

arch.note: DualSetSequence.forward currently drops return_attn; this probe calls encoder / AttnPool / CausalTransformer directly.

attn.scaler_note: LFP z-score fit on 6 other sessions (LSO train is all other sessions; this is a stand-in). Band ranking and attention geometry are the target, not a reprint of fold concat R².
